title: Guinobatan Half Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2026 Race Was Like
seo_title: Guinobatan Half Marathon 2026 Review: Start Times, Weather, Field
meta_description: Guinobatan Half Marathon 2026 review: a 4.30am start from the town plaza, 25°C with light rain and a stiff breeze, 97 half-marathon finishers and how fast they ran.
dek: What the 2026 Guinobatan Half Marathon in Albay was like to run: the early starts, a damp and breezy race morning, and how fast a small provincial field finished.
verdict: Enter if you want a small, early-morning half marathon in Albay where a club runner can finish near the front. The 2026 race started at 4.30am from Guinobatan Town Plaza in about 25°C air, after light overnight rain and with a steady breeze. Ninety-seven runners finished the half; just over half of them broke 2:30, and a sub-1:50 time was enough for the top ten. Little else was published about the course, so ask the organiser for the route before you travel.

sections.heading: The Start: Early, From the Town Plaza
paragraphs: The 2026 race started and finished at Guinobatan Town Plaza on Sunday 9 August. The results put the half-marathon gun at 4.30am, the 10 km at 4.45am and the 5 km at 5am [1]. The last half marathoner finished at 7.57am, so most of the field ran the first hour in the dark.
No route map or course description was published with the results [1]. Ask the organiser for the route before race day if you want to know where the climbs and turns are.

sections.heading: The Weather: Damp, Humid and Breezy
paragraphs: Open-Meteo's modelled hourly weather for Guinobatan shows light rain through the night, about 2 mm an hour at 2am and 3am, easing to 1.1 mm at 4am and 0.6 mm at 5am, and dry from 6am. At the 4.30am start it was about 25°C with a dew point of 24.5°C and 97% to 98% humidity, under full cloud, with a steady wind of about 20 km/h [2].

It warmed slowly: 25.4°C at 6am, 26.2°C at 7am and 27.6°C with 88% humidity at 8am [2]. That is mild for a Philippine August morning, but the air is close to saturated, so sweat barely evaporates. Expect wet roads early on and a breeze that helps cooling on exposed stretches.

sections.heading: Cut-offs and Finishing Times
paragraphs: No cut-off times were published with the results. The slowest recorded finishes were 3:26:39 in the half marathon and 2:04:35 in the 10 km [1]. Results are given as gun times; in fields this small, most runners cross the start line within seconds of the gun.

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: The half marathon had 97 finishers. The winner ran 1:18:18, more than eight minutes clear of second place, and tenth place was 1:49:00. The median was 2:28:45 and the 90th percentile 3:13:17. Seventeen runners (18%) broke two hours and 54 (56%) broke 2:30. Women made up 18% of the half-marathon field, and the fastest woman ran 1:48:51, inside the overall top ten [1].

The 10 km was quicker at the front: the top two shared 36:03 and tenth place was 44:59. Its median was 1:20:31, with 33 of 173 finishers (19%) inside an hour, and 39% of its finishers were women. A further 218 people finished the 5 km [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the Guinobatan Half Marathon?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a low-key provincial half marathon with an early start and a realistic chance of a top-ten or age-group finish: in 2026 a time under 1:50 was enough for the top ten, and a 2:30 put you in the faster half of the field.

Think twice if you want a published course, a big field to run with, or a fast time in dry air. With 97 half-marathon finishers, expect to run on your own for long stretches. Check the route and any cut-off with the organiser, since none were published with the 2026 results.
Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on the official results and modelled historical weather.

faqs.question: What time does the Guinobatan Half Marathon start?
faqs.answer: Early. In 2026 the half marathon started at 4.30am on Sunday 9 August, the 10 km at 4.45am and the 5 km at 5am, all from Guinobatan Town Plaza in Albay. The times come from the official results, and the last half-marathon finisher came in just before 8am. Check the organiser's notice for the next edition.

faqs.question: What was the weather like at the 2026 Guinobatan Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: Mild, wet and breezy. Modelled weather for Guinobatan gave about 25°C at the 4.30am start, with 97% to 98% humidity, a wind of about 20 km/h and light rain that stopped by 6am. It reached 27.6°C and 88% humidity by 8am, when nearly every runner had finished.

faqs.question: How fast do you need to be to place at the Guinobatan Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: Not very fast. In 2026, 97 runners finished the half marathon, and tenth place was 1:49:00. The winner ran 1:18:18, the median was 2:28:45, and 56% broke 2:30. In the 10 km, tenth place was 44:59. A good club runner has a real chance of a top-ten finish.
